title: Ko Riiwtaa E nder Jardiin
intro: Tagɗo sirlu meeɗiino hoɗde e darnde tagoore ɓurnde toowde, ɓurnde ɓadaade Alla ko heewɓe mbaawi faamde. Kono mawnikinaare ƴettii ɗaɗi, gollal gootal ƴaañorgal wayli laawol nguurndam. Jooni noon, ooɗoo tagoore ina ƴaañii no gaño hunnaaɗo nii, ina ɓuuɓtoo ina ƴakka haa ñalawma fodanooɗo oo ari. Mbele aɗa waawi udditaade sifaa oo dogɗo?
clues: Mi meeɗiino wonde e ɓurɓe ɓadaade gonndigal Alla, toowngal dow ko heewi e tagoore.
Mi tagaa ko e huunde ɓuuɓnde, wonaa e leydi walla e loope.
Nde yamiraa mi sujjande yeeso tagoore hesere, mi salii — riiwtude ko cikku mi ko ɓural am.
Mi riiwaa, mi huɗaama, kono haa jooni mi rokkaama balɗe haa waktu anndaaɗo, toɗɗaaɗo.
Mi huniima majjude ko mbaawmi fof, mi ɓadtoo ɓiɓɓe Aadama gila e kala bannge.
Miin ko mi gaño udditiiɗo, bayyinaaɗo e neɗɗaagal fof, sahaa fof ina feññina, ina ɓuuɓtoo haa joofni toɗɗaaɗo oo.

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verse: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all (15:39)
